prompt: Create one production-ready transparent 2D game sprite parts plate to REPAIR the arms of the orange fox swordsman in the two reference illustrations. References are STYLE AND CHARACTER IDENTITY, not elements to copy into the background. Match exact vivid orange fur, small cream wrist tufts, very dark brown paws, thick clean dark outline, flat/cel-shaded hand-drawn fantasy cartoon. Deliver ONE 3 columns x 2 rows modular parts sheet, transparent alpha, generous empty gutters, no labels, no text, no borders. All five items must be completely separated with full transparent space and complete silhouettes. Top left: a FRONT VIEW LEFT FREE ARM only, short chubby furry arm from a complete rounded orange shoulder cap to a relaxed closed dark paw at bottom, hanging down with very gentle elbow bend. Top middle: FRONT VIEW RIGHT GRIPPING ARM only, same shoulder-to-paw length, gently angled down-right, elbow flexed subtly, one closed dark gripping paw with readable fingers, ivory fur cuff ONLY at wrist, no weapon or sword fragments. Top right: the COMPLETE SWORD ONLY, upright vertical, narrow silver-gray short straight blade with faceted shading and black outline, gold crossguard, plain dark brown wrapped handle and round gold pommel, NO HAND, NO ARM. Bottom left: BACK VIEW LEFT FREE ARM only, true rear surface of the same arm hanging down, orange fur, small cream wrist cuff and dark paw back, no palm pads, no torso fragments. Bottom middle: BACK VIEW RIGHT GRIPPING ARM only, true rear view, naturally hanging down with slight outward elbow bend and closed gripping paw near bottom, NO SWORD. Bottom right: entirely empty. Arm designs must be suitable for overlapping shoulder/upper-arm/forearm/hand Spine animation: complete solid orange rounded shoulder caps, complete elbow connection, no exposed cut black line across shoulder top, no detached fragments, no detached fur islands, no chest, no belly, no neck/scarf, no head, no tail, no legs, no duplicate hands. Front and back are genuinely distinct surface views, not mirrored duplicates. Arms are compact and anatomical, not stretched horizontal clubs. Make each arm 2.2 times as tall as its maximum width. Keep all four arms matching scale. Sword length around 1.65 times arm length. Return sharp polished high-resolution sprites on real transparent alpha.
